zh: 修复手机上输入框获得焦点后被键盘盖住，输入文字在触屏设备上至少 16px，页面不再被 iOS 放大，浏览器工具栏的几像素变化也不再被当作键盘
en: Fix the composer being covered by the keyboard on a phone, with the field's text at least 16px on touch devices so iOS no longer zooms the page, and the browser toolbar moving by a few pixels no longer taken for a keyboard
